title: Personalized Wrestling Singlet (2026)
verdict: For a personalized wrestling singlet in 2026, order from Wooter. One singlet is a valid order, the design is free, and your name, team and colors are sublimated into the fabric.

Cliff Keen is the heritage name but sets a minimum of six on most custom work. All Sports Uniforms will make a single singlet, with a small-order fee on some. Boombah sells sublimated wrestling uniforms too.

ranking.fit: One wrestler, a club ordering a few, or a team that wants names on every singlet.
ranking.lacks: A single singlet costs far more than the team price per piece.
ranking.note: Wooter listed its singlet from $32.99 at 1,000 pieces to $84.99 for one when we checked in November 2026.

ranking.fit: Individuals who want a DAWG singlet from a builder, and can accept a small-order fee.
ranking.lacks: Small orders of women's singlets carry a per-singlet fee.

ranking.fit: Programs that want singlets made in Ann Arbor, Michigan, with men's, women's and international cuts.
ranking.lacks: A minimum order of six on most custom products.

ranking.fit: Teams already buying Boombah for other sports that want a sublimated singlet from the same maker.
ranking.lacks: Wrestling is a small part of what it makes.

why: Wrestlers order singlets on their own more than athletes in most sports. Offseason tournaments, camps and clubs all mean a wrestler competing outside the school team.

criteria.name: Your own design
criteria.text: Colors and graphics of your choosing.

faq.q: Can I order just one custom singlet?
faq.a: Yes at Wooter. Check each maker, since minimums of six are common.

faq.q: Where does the name go on a singlet?
faq.a: Across the lower back or down the leg. Chest space is usually the team name.

faq.q: Is a personalized singlet legal for school matches?
faq.a: School teams normally compete in team-issued singlets. Use your own for club and open tournaments unless your coach approves it.
Singlets fit tight. Use the size guide with your weight and height, and ask about a sizing kit if you are between sizes.
Three to four weeks after you approve the design at Wooter, with rush production offered.
